annotation.title_clean: The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2022
annotation.title_en: The Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2022
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Secretary of State for Transport (UK); published by King's Printer of Acts of Parliament
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument bringing Part 1 (sections 1–8, Schedules 1–2) of the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 into force on 18 February 2022. Part 1 concerns airspace change proposals and directions powers; the unmanned aircraft provisions were commenced earlier.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commences sections 1–8 and Schedules 1–2 of the 2021 Act on 18 February 2022.
Part 1 gives the Secretary of State (delegable to the CAA) powers to direct airspace change proposals.
Extends to England and Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.
Brings into force the last remaining provisions of the Act.
